newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate rises to 5.48 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate rises to 5.48 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for ten million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills edged up to 5.48 percent from 5.46 percent last week, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price fell to 98.633 from 98.638 and the minimum price accepted was 98.621.
Banks submitted bids for 32.5 million dinars worth of bills, up from 19.5 million dinars the previous week.
The bills, maturing on June 4, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
